diagnostics.explanation: The character is not part of the language. DARM has no braces, semicolons, single-quoted strings or division.
diagnostics.title: unexpected character

diagnostics.explanation: Indentation must use spaces only, so that the block structure is the same in every editor.
diagnostics.title: tab in indentation

diagnostics.explanation: A line is indented less than its block but does not line up with any enclosing block.
diagnostics.title: inconsistent indentation

diagnostics.explanation: A string must be closed on the line where it starts. Use a """ block for text that spans lines.
diagnostics.title: unterminated string

diagnostics.explanation: Only \" \\ \n \t \u{...} and the markup escapes \* \[ \] \{ \} \` are recognised.
diagnostics.title: invalid escape

diagnostics.explanation: Numbers may carry the suffixes % (percent), ms and s (durations); nothing else.
diagnostics.title: invalid number

diagnostics.explanation: Source files must be UTF-8 encoded text.
diagnostics.title: not UTF-8

diagnostics.explanation: A `(` or `[` has no matching `)` or `]`.
diagnostics.title: unclosed bracket

diagnostics.explanation: Every .darml file starts with `darm 1`, the grammar version it is written in.
diagnostics.title: missing version line

diagnostics.explanation: The file asks for a grammar version this compiler does not implement.
diagnostics.title: unsupported grammar version

diagnostics.explanation: The parser found a token it did not expect. The message names what was expected. Common causes: a missing comma between arguments, `=` where `==` was meant, `True` instead of `true`.
diagnostics.title: syntax error

diagnostics.explanation: A line ending in `:` must be followed by an indented block.
diagnostics.title: missing block

diagnostics.explanation: A line is indented deeper than the previous one, but the previous line does not end with `:`.
diagnostics.title: unexpected indentation

diagnostics.explanation: `elif` and `else` must directly follow an `if` block at the same indentation.
diagnostics.title: `elif`/`else` without `if`

diagnostics.explanation: Positional arguments come first.
diagnostics.title: positional argument after named argument

diagnostics.explanation: The contents of a block go on the following lines, indented.
diagnostics.title: block on the same line

diagnostics.explanation: The name is neither a built-in element nor a component defined in the project.
diagnostics.title: unknown element

diagnostics.explanation: Each element has a place: top-level statements (`book`, `chapter`, …) cannot be nested, content blocks need a `chapter`, actions need a `button`/`option`/`on_correct` body, and so on.
diagnostics.title: element not allowed here

diagnostics.explanation: The element or block does not take an argument with this name. `darm reference` lists what each one accepts.
diagnostics.title: unknown argument or property

diagnostics.explanation: The name is not declared in an `assets:` block.
diagnostics.title: unknown asset

diagnostics.explanation: A `goto`, link or `goto=` argument names an id that no chapter, section or block declares.
diagnostics.title: unknown jump target

diagnostics.explanation: Ids, asset names, state variables, component names, properties and named arguments must be unique.
diagnostics.title: duplicate definition

diagnostics.explanation: The argument needs a different kind of value (for example a string where a number was given).
diagnostics.title: wrong type of value

diagnostics.explanation: A required argument, property or child is absent.
diagnostics.title: missing required argument or property

diagnostics.explanation: A component was called with the wrong arguments, calls itself, or nests too deeply.
diagnostics.title: invalid component use

diagnostics.explanation: The name is not declared in a `state:` block.
diagnostics.title: unknown state variable

diagnostics.explanation: Arithmetic and ordering need integers, `and`/`or`/`not` need booleans, and `==`/`!=` need two values of the same type.
diagnostics.title: type error in expression

diagnostics.explanation: The value has the right type but is out of range, not one of the allowed words, or malformed (colours are "#rrggbb").
diagnostics.title: invalid value

diagnostics.explanation: The project is missing something structural (no `book`, no chapters) or an element has a block it cannot take / lacks one it needs.
diagnostics.title: invalid structure

diagnostics.explanation: Inline markup is unbalanced or a link target is malformed. Escape literal markup characters with a backslash.
diagnostics.title: invalid rich text

diagnostics.explanation: The source exceeds one of the documented limits (nesting depth, number of options, …).
diagnostics.title: limit exceeded

diagnostics.explanation: Blocks inside `page` need `at=` and `size=` inside the page; outside a `page` they must not have them; `page` must be a direct child of `chapter`; a `fixed` book contains only pages.
diagnostics.title: fixed-page rule violated

diagnostics.explanation: `cover`, `start`, `contents`, `end` and names starting with `_` are reserved; built-in element names cannot be reused for components.
diagnostics.title: reserved name

diagnostics.explanation: A declared asset (or cover image, poster, captions file) does not exist at that path. Paths are relative to the source file that declares them.
diagnostics.title: file not found

diagnostics.explanation: Asset and include paths must be relative and stay inside the project directory.
diagnostics.title: path outside the project

diagnostics.explanation: Files are identified by content. The file is not one of the formats the constructor accepts, or it is damaged.
diagnostics.title: unsupported or mismatched file format

diagnostics.explanation: The file could not be read, or exceeds the size limit.
diagnostics.title: unreadable or oversized file

diagnostics.explanation: SVG images must be static and self-contained: no scripts, event handlers, animation elements, `foreignObject` or external references.
diagnostics.title: unsafe SVG

diagnostics.explanation: Remote assets need `offline = false`, an https URL and the URL's host in the book's `network` list.
diagnostics.title: remote asset not permitted

diagnostics.explanation: Caption files must be WebVTT: UTF-8, first line `WEBVTT`, at least one cue.
diagnostics.title: invalid captions

diagnostics.explanation: The included file does not exist, is included twice, forms a cycle, or includes nest deeper than 16.
diagnostics.title: include failed

diagnostics.explanation: The project file is malformed or names an entry file that does not exist.
diagnostics.title: invalid darm.toml

diagnostics.explanation: The output file or directory could not be written.
diagnostics.title: cannot write output

diagnostics.explanation: The encryption options are incomplete or contradictory (for example `--encrypt` without a password source or key file).
diagnostics.title: invalid protection options

diagnostics.explanation: The compiler produced an IR that failed its own validation. This is a bug in DARM; please report it with the source that triggers it.
diagnostics.title: internal compiler error

diagnostics.explanation: The project has no `cover:` block, so a deterministic typographic cover was generated from the title, author and book id.
diagnostics.title: generated front cover

diagnostics.explanation: The project has no `back_cover:` block, so one was generated from the description.
diagnostics.title: generated back cover

diagnostics.explanation: The asset is declared and will be packaged, but nothing refers to it.
diagnostics.title: unused asset

diagnostics.explanation: A state variable is never read, or a component is never used.
diagnostics.title: unused definition

diagnostics.explanation: The chapter has no content.
diagnostics.title: empty chapter

diagnostics.explanation: The asset is larger than 64 MiB; consider a smaller encode for comfortable downloads and imports.
diagnostics.title: large asset
